outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D rendering/model of segmented tomographic structures (preconoidal rings, apical polar ring, actin) — a schematic/structural illustration, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a 3D rendering/model of segmented cellular structures (IMC, ER, cytosolic actin) — an illustrative model, not a plot.
Panel C is a tomogram slice (micrograph) with filaments highlighted in green; it is an image, not a quantitative plot of averages.
Panel D is a schematic/cartoon lateral section illustrating actin and IMC organization, not a data plot.
Panel E is a slice through an averaged subtomogram volume shown as a micrograph-like image, not a chart with summary statistics requiring individual points.
Panel F is a tomogram slice (micrograph) showing a specific observed instance (N = 2 noted in image), not a plot of averaged data.
